review_mode: Shape hypotheses known beforehand; manual source-image inspection, not blind selection or object autopsy.

limits: These are Mahadevan editorial variant groupings, not independently established ancient semantic equivalences.
A variant list documents selected representative forms; it does not establish an exhaustive invariant for every ancient occurrence.
No two-sided original artifact images or complete per-code occurrence lists were inspected.
Roof presence/absence is coarser than identity of stroke sequence, exact position, physical separation or detachable component status.
No added roof identified as tokenM134, no sign splitting, and no global allograph or linguistic claim.
conclusion: Documented rows retain unroofed137/162 and roofed334, but base geometry varies, especially162. The source supports qualified representative roof comparisons, not a universal exact add-roof transformation.
